findings.text: the negative-control paragraph says the eight base ids comprise the three the node attributes to product defects and the five it repaired, but the log it names, base_foreground/negative_control.log, holds eight FAILED lines that split two attributed (both skill-file ids in test_skill_contracts) and six repaired, and the control loop in foreground_verify.sh never runs test_crew_monitor_output.py where the third product-defect id lives, so the published split contradicts its own receipt even though the total of eight agrees.

item_verdicts.diff: One commit b4bef72b is +466/-19 across ten files, moving six test files' stale assertions onto the shipped behaviour with no test added, removed, skipped or xfailed, and carrying the plan landing section, the figure and the cumulative evidence record.
item_verdicts.done_when: Read from the node's own per-file logs, one pytest process per owned file with its own basetemp in the node's worktree, ten base failing ids became four, every survivor was already red at base, and no node id moved from pass to fail.
item_verdicts.goal: Every id this node owns appears verbatim in docs/research/suite-failures-at-head.html section 4, and all ten are resolved one way or the other: six pass at head and four remain red, each of the four named in follow_ons with its node id, file and line and evidence that the behaviour rather than the assertion is wrong.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest records ten base ids, six repairs, three product-defect attributions and one environment attribution with a zero-added comparison, and its negative_control_log line is the bare path whose first line repeats the declared string verbatim.
item_verdicts.write_paths: All ten changed paths in commit b4bef72b sit inside the eleven declared write paths, and the two declared test files with nothing repaired are correctly absent from the diff.

justifications.durability: Each repaired assertion was read against the shipped source it names and each attribution was independently reproduced -- the renderer defect in one interpreter at negative_control_native.log, the read-set budget 18670 against FIXED_READ_SET_TOKEN_BUDGET 17000 at tests/test_skill_contracts.py:591, and the undocumented crew check-manifest verb registered at reckon/cli.py:2767.
justifications.evidence: The base and head per-file logs exist and corroborate every count, but the evidence record's own sentence at docs/evidence/archive/the-suite-is-green-at-head-landed.html:174 misstates the control's composition.
justifications.fit: The repairs are the minimal move of each stale assertion onto the shipped behaviour, matching the node's declared six-file repair class and adding no test and no production change.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/research/suite-failures-at-head.html section 4's ten ids for this node are all accounted for, and the four survivors each cite file and line -- reckon/crew/recovery.py:4765, skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md at tests/test_skill_contracts.py:594 and :1019, and tests/test_spa_module_scope.py:331.
justifications.scope_discipline: The commit's ten changed paths are all inside the declared eleven, and the four ids this node may not repair in place are reported under follow_ons rather than touched, as plan section 2 requires.
